_comment: Stack Profile Template - Configure your technology stack
_controls_options: base - Baseline quality and verification (recommended for all)
regulated - Additional controls for regulated environments (finance, healthcare, government)
_stacks_description: Choose modules for your technology stack
_frontend_options: frontend/next-tailwind - Next.js with App Router and Tailwind
frontend/angular-tailwind - Angular with standalone components and Signals
_testing_options: testing/visual-parity - Visual regression testing with Playwright

_usage_instructions.step_1: Copy this file to your project root as 'stack.profile.json'
_usage_instructions.step_2: Remove all '_comment' and '_*' fields (they're just documentation)
_usage_instructions.step_5: Choose 'stacks' modules for your technology stack
_usage_instructions.step_6: Run install_environment tool or copy modules manually

_anti_patterns.missing_enterprise: ERROR: 'enterprise' field is required, must be ""
_anti_patterns.invalid_module_id: ERROR: Module IDs are case-sensitive, check spelling
_anti_patterns.empty_stacks: WARNING: No stacks selected, only enterprise standards will be installed
_anti_patterns.duplicate_modules: WARNING: Same module listed multiple times
_anti_patterns.incompatible_cloud: WARNING: Selecting multiple cloud providers (choose one)
